effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom in enter).
The vault mints previewDeposit(assets) roxpUSDC shares to `onBehalf`. The exchange rate in storage sets the share count, and the signer sets no minimum.
Interest and fees accrue first (accrueInterest), so fee shares are minted to the fee recipients before the share price is computed.
formats.shown: Deposit 4 USDC for the recipient address, with roxpUSDC named as the share ticker and the share recipient shown.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many roxpUSDC shares the recipient receives; the vault rate sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The function has no minShares parameter. Case 0: the signer receives 4 roxpUSDC (4e18), and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: roxpUSDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The share count comes from storage, and calldata carries no bound.

cases.notes: USDC out (4) is shown right. The roxpUSDC shares that arrive are shown by ticker and recipient but not by amount, because the amount comes from storage.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) roxpUSDC shares from `onBehalf`, rounded up. The exchange rate sets the count, and the signer sets no maximum.
When the caller is not `onBehalf`, the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` drops by the shares burned.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`. It first pulls USDC from the liquidity adapter when idle USDC is not enough.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly N USDC to the receiver, with the owner whose shares are used shown as its own field.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many roxpUSDC shares are burned; the vault rate sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. exit calls `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: the signer loses 1,879,083.02 roxpUSDC, and no screen field states a share amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The share count comes from storage, and calldata carries no bound.

cases.notes: USDC in (1,880,000) to the signer is shown right. The reader guessed that shares leave but had no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` roxpUSDC from `onBehalf`. When the caller is not `onBehalf`, it spends the caller's share allowance.
The vault sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC to `receiver`. The exchange rate sets the amount, and the signer sets no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem X roxpUSDC to the receiver, with the owner shown. Nothing names the asset that the receiver gets.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets; the sibling mint format shows it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. The redeem format fields are 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner', with no underlying asset. The mint format has `{"label":"Deposit asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Case 3: the signer receives 1,608,640.904533 USDC, and the reader was unsure whether the payout is USDC.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Change interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem cannot show how much USDC the receiver gets; the vault rate sets it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. The function has no minAssets parameter.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The amount comes from storage.

cases.notes: Shares out (1,607,537.0995 roxpUSDC) are shown right. The USDC that arrives has no asset name and no amount on screen. The reader guessed USDC with no amount.

effects: The signer sends previewMint(shares) USDC to the vault, rounded up. The exchange rate sets the amount, and the signer sets no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` roxpUSDC to `onBehalf`.
formats.shown: Mint 1 roxpUSDC for the recipient address, with 'Deposit asset: USDC' but no USDC amount.

findings.title: mint intent and sentence omit that the signer pays USDC; only a separate ticker field hints at it.
findings.evidence: Descriptor mint: intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". VaultV2.sol enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets);`. Case 1: 1 USDC leaves the signer, and the sentence reads 'Mint 1 roxpUSDC for 0x...dEaD'.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Pay USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}" and intent to "Deposit USDC to mint shares".

findings.title: mint cannot show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault rate sets it, with no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The function has no maxAssets parameter. Case 1: 1 USDC leaves the signer, and the screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. The amount comes from storage.

cases.notes: USDC out (1 USDC) is named by ticker only, with no amount. The minted shares go to 0x...dEaD (not the signer), and the screen shows that right.
